provenance.access_terms: MIT; noncommercial research profile; selection is lexical-first pinned entity, official split suffixes train[16479:] and test[16479:] before labels are read
provenance.attribution: Su et al., Robust Anomaly Detection for Multivariate Time Series through Stochastic Recurrent Neural Network, KDD 2019, OmniAnomaly supplementary SMD

scope: All selected training rows/sensors. Manifest has no original timestamp column; no UTC values invented. Time-based trend/ACF unavailable with reason.

notes: Descriptive only; no model fitting, interpolation or missing-value imputation.
Sample standard deviation/variance use ddof=1; kurtosis is unbiased excess kurtosis.
Correlations use pairwise finite values and do not establish causality.
Autocorrelation requires an ordered regular UTC grid; missing sensor pairs stay missing.
